notes: Demo calibration for data/samples/gate_traffic.mp4. That clip is a two-way public road, not a parking barrier: over its first 30 s (YOLO+ByteTrack, stride 3) traffic crossed the centre vertical in both directions - 4 tracks left-to-right and 4 right-to-left at x=0.50, and 13 of the 31 tracks long enough to judge barely moved at all. So both lines sit on the same segment with opposite directions, which is a single bidirectional lane: whichever way a vehicle passes it, one role matches and the other is a reversal. The zone excludes the 10% frame margins, where vehicles appear and disappear instead of crossing. Re-draw this with scripts/calibrate.py --gate for a real gate camera.
